channel.title: Mobile | Marco Troisi
channel.description: Marco Troisi is a founder, fractional CTO and software architect. Through O2A Labs he helps founders make sound technical decisions and build software that serves the business.

item.title: Native apps are faster than web apps. Ok, what’s the news?
item.description: I honestly don’t understand what’s the point of a post trying to convince people that web apps are slower than native apps. I don’t understand it, and I think I have good reasons for that.

item.title: Make your website available offline with HTML5
item.description: One of the really cool things HTML5 allows to do is to make our web apps available even when our visitors are not connected to any network (assuming, obviously, that they have visited the website before, under network coverage).

item.title: A List Apart
item.description: I recently found a very interesting and relevant blog/magazine for web developers: A List Apart. “A List Apart Magazine… explores the design, development, and meaning of web content, with a special focus on web standards and best practices.” (from http://www.alistapart.com/about/).

item.title: Why should you develop web apps
item.description: So I want to start my blog with one of the arguments that have thrilled me in recent times more than anything else in the programming world: the web app vs native app thing.
